title: Ceramics & Composites
short: Engineered ceramics, coatings and composites for heat, wear, the body and beyond.
overview: Ceramics and composites combine materials to reach properties no single phase can provide. Research here covers structural and functional ceramics, metal matrix and nanocomposites, functionally graded materials, glass and glass-ceramics, and ceramic and composite biomaterials for bone repair.

Processing routes such as powder metallurgy, spark plasma sintering, thermal spraying and electrodeposition are studied together with the mechanical, tribological and corrosion behaviour of the finished material.
